source_title: Abhishek Sharma, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi set new world record in India's 3rd T20I win over New Zealand - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Abhishek Sharma and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi produced a breathtaking batting display against New Zealand in Wellington, recording the highest run rate for a 100-plus opening partnership in men's T20 internationals.The Indian duo scored at an astonishing 18.13 runs per over, surpassing the previous record of 16.08 set by England's Jos Buttler and Phil Salt against South Africa at Old Trafford in 2025.Abhishek led the assault with a spectacular 113 off 38 balls, reaching his century in just 35 deliveries. Meanwhile, 15-year-old Sooryavanshi smashed 45 from 18 balls, ensuring New Zealand's bowlers had little respite.Their opening stand yielded 133 runs in just seven overs, helping India race to a record 118 without loss in the powerplay while chasing 199.
